exposure: Women with a scarred uterus without placenta previa and PAS
Presence of placenta previa and PAS
cohort: 3722 singleton pregnant women with a scarred uterus who underwent a cesarean delivery in a large teaching hospital in north China between January 2013 and December 2017
finding: Six factors were identified as being associated with PPH in women with a scarred uterus undergoing cesarean delivery: maternal age, placental location, placenta previa, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, fetal position, and placenta accreta spectrum.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on cesarean deliveries in women with scarred uteruses, indicating a previous cesarean delivery.
